component.name: Timewizer
component.summary: Build school timetables on your own computer

description.p: Timewizer is a timetable maker for a single school. Enter your teachers, classes, rooms and lessons, and Timewizer places every lesson so that nobody is in two places at once.
It works fully offline, with no account or login. Each school is one file you can save, copy and open again.

ul.li: Morning and afternoon shifts, with their own periods and bell times for each day
Teacher limits, time off, rooms, double periods and lessons that must happen at the same time
Import from Excel or CSV, with a clear message for every row that cannot be imported
Check before building, with problems explained in plain English
Drag and drop editing with swap, lock and undo, and a quality improver
Print or export timetables as PDF, pictures, Excel or CSV for every class, teacher and room
Light and dark mode

screenshot.caption: A class timetable, with lessons coloured by subject
The master view shows every class at once
Dragging a lesson: free slots are green, blocked slots are red (dark mode)

ul.li: Backups to a folder of your choice: back up now or on every save, keep the newest copies, restore as a new file
Teacher substitutions: absences for days or single periods, suggested cover teachers, cover counts and a printable cover sheet
A change history for timetable edits, with undo and redo
Locked lessons that stop a build are named, and drag colours explain every rule
Excel and CSV export of the chosen class, teacher, room and master timetables, with each day's times
A short start-up animation that can be switched off

description.p: Much faster for very large schools, and a better snap icon.

ul.li: Dragging, moving and swapping lessons, and Improve quality, now take a fraction of a second on schools with thousands of sessions
The Master view opens, zooms and scrolls about ten times faster
A repair step places sessions that were left over after building
Fixed a class getting two sessions of one subject on a day for a group that should have had only one
Names with commas, like "Khan, Ayesha", now import correctly
Taking one lesson of a same-time pair off the timetable now takes its partner too
School files are checked when they open, with a clear message if one is damaged
The app only reads and writes files you choose
